abstract: CROST (https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/crost) is a public spatial transcriptomics resource that offers curated datasets, standardized analytical results, structured spatial knowledge, and interactive exploration tools. In version 2.0, our collection has expanded to 544 projects and 3538 samples, nearly a three-fold increase from version 1.0 (182 projects and 1033 samples). We have also substantially expanded the derived resources for spatial colocalization and spatially variable cancer genes. To facilitate spatial microenvironment analysis, CROST 2.0 introduces an analytical framework comprising niche-associated differential expression, spatially resolved gene-set activity analysis, spatial interaction hotspot and topic analyses, and molecular and cell-type niche analysis. CROST 2.0 also provides the Spatial Compare function to compare spatial gene expression, cell-type distributions, and niche composition across samples. It introduces the Cancer NicheDE module to systematically characterize cancer niche-associated differential expression and integrates an online cell-type annotation tool, SCType, enabling the use of single-cell reference information in spatial transcriptomic analysis. These updates extend CROST into an integrated spatial transcriptomics resource for characterizing spatial microenvironments, investigating cancer-associated spatial features, and comparing spatial patterns across samples.
